title: Adequate for the Amateur Juicer
text:
Adequate for the Amateur Juicer. Juicing is a great way to improve health. You can purchase pre- made juice, but if you really want to taste juice in its most natural form, you need to produce your own. For that, you need a small appliance to extract juice and one possible option is the AmazonBasics Wide-Mouth, 2-Speed Centrifugal Juicer with Juice Jug and Pulp Container, Black.

Utilitarian in design and functionality, this juicer has two speed settings and consists of the usual parts: Extractor/centrifuge, pulp container, chute, and plastic pusher to press the fruits and veggies through the opening along with a plastic measuring cup to catch the juice. You just turn the device on, place the plastic cup under the spout, and start pushing fruits and veggies through the opening. In a matter of minutes, you will have a serving of high- nutrient green juice, ready for consumption.

I’ve owned my share of juicers and I like them for the healthfulness that they encourage. This AmazonBasics juicer, compared to others I’ve owned, is very middle of the road overall. Among its positive points, it takes up little countertop space and I like the included plastic cup and the way it hooks itself under the spout. The measurements on the cup are handy, too, because this way you know exactly how much juice you are drinking.

Looking for cons, I am able to find a few. My greatest problem is that the centrifuge itself isn’t as efficient as it should be. It loses its grip on too much of the food contents, hurling them into the pulp container to discard. I often use kale when I juice and more often than not, I will find large pieces of kale in the pulp container. This shouldn’t happen. The juicer should be able to grip the pieces of food and extract more juice than this. I have been tempted to take the contents of the pulp container and run them through the juicer a second time for this reason.

Another concern I have with this juicer is that it seems to be working really, really hard to extract the juice. The extractor slows down as you push the food through, which is normal, but it makes an agonizing sound. And this makes me question the juicer’s durability. It seems like it will burn itself out with frequent use.

Fresh juice is a great addition to anyone’s diet. A good juicing machine is a necessary appliance when you want to make your own and the AmazonBasics Wide-Mouth, 2-Speed Centrifugal Juicer with Juice Jug and Pulp Container is one solution, albeit a weak one, to your quest for better health. It’s fine for those who only juice every now and then, but it will prove woefully inadequate for the more serious juicers in our ranks.
